source_note: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题
english_source_note: Boundedness of Partial Sums of Highly Oscillatory Sequences
callout_id: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题#6
statement_en: Let $$S_N:=\sum_{n\leq N}\sin(n^2).$$ Prove or disprove that there exists a positive real number $C$ such that $$\limsup_{N\to \infty}\frac{|S_N|}{\sqrt{N\log\log N}}=C.$$
key_techniques: fine asymptotic analysis of oscillatory sums
callout_body: 令$$S_N:=\sum_{n\leq N}\sin(n^2)$$证明或证伪，存在正实数$C$使得$$\limsup_{N\to \infty}\frac{|S_N|}{\sqrt{N\log\log N}}=C$$
